summary: Phase 6 (FR-7/8) Red+Green commit reviewed and a blocking prompt-injection vector fixed. FR-7 rate-limit banner is clear, structured, and references the Postgres-backed migration path. FR-8 Zod schema correctly validates the chat input contract. FR-8 role-marker sanitization was extended to strip bracketed variants such as '[COACH]:' because the closing marker was changed to '[COACH]:' and the original regex only stripped whitespace-bounded 'COACH:' / 'REP:'. All gate commands pass after the fix.

nonblocking_findings.detail: Closing marker '[COACH]:' is consistent with the bracketed turn format but uses a trailing colon, while internal assistant turns use '[COACH] <content>' without a colon. This is intentional (signals generation point) and sanitized, but slightly inconsistent.

Tests do not assert the exact sanitized content string; they rely on negative regex matches and occurrence counts. This is sufficient for regression detection but could be strengthened with a snapshot of the sanitized prompt.

evidence.item: FR-7 banner in apps/sales-advantage/lib/rate-limit.ts is a structured block documenting per-process Map limitation and migration path to rate_limiter_v2_20260603.
checkRateLimit() JSDoc references the banner and the Postgres-backed migration path.
FR-8 chatInputSchema validates messages as 1..50 items, role as 'user'|'assistant', content as non-empty string <= 8000 chars, and optional lessonId/moduleId strings.
All 5 Zod rejection cases (missing messages, empty messages, missing content, non-string content, unknown role) return 400 and do not call streamText.
Original regex /(^|\s)(REP|COACH):/gi did not strip '[COACH]:' because '[' is not whitespace or start-of-string, allowing injection through the new closing marker. This was a blocker.
Fixed regex /\[(?:REP|COACH)\]:?|(^|\s)(?:REP|COACH):/gi strips both bracketed markers (e.g. '[COACH]:', '[REP]') and whitespace-bounded plain markers (e.g. '\nCOACH:').
Added route-level regression test for '[COACH]:' injection that asserts only the legitimate closing marker remains in the assembled prompt.
Fix committed as 0b19795f 'fix(sales): bracketed role-marker injection (track_id: review_findings_remediation_20260624)'.
